issues.detail: The Greek 'εαν δουλευσωσιν' is a conditional clause (if they serve), but the Vietnamese 'mà chúng nó sẽ phục dịch' renders it as a relative/subordinate clause (whom they will serve). The Greek implies 'if they serve [me], I will judge them', whereas the Vietnamese suggests 'I will judge the nations that they will serve'.
